disorder-name.detail: DSM-5 obsessive-compulsive disorder; 100 first-episode, untreated patients recruited from outpatient psychiatry services.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A total of 100 first-episode, untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. Diagnosis was established independently by two experienced psychiatrists according to the criteria outlined in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) for OCD."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single-site cohort from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, China. No publicly named dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "A total of 100 first-episode, untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."

age.detail: Overall OCD clinical cohort (N=100). Min and max not reported.
